h: Divine Help Sustains Our Work Toward Lasting Redemption

p: אֵשֶׁת חַיִל מִי יִמְצָא (מִשְׁלֵי לא, י)
"A woman of valor, who can find?" (Mishlei 31:10).
"'A woman of valor': this is Knesses Yisrael,
of many legions and many camps
וְהוּא עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר (תְּהִלִּים לג, טז-יז)
This is according to what it says (Tehillim 33:16-17):
"The king is not saved by a great army;
a mighty man is not rescued by great strength;
the horse is a falsehood for salvation," etc.
And we said that this refers to the three things
"in your mouth and in your heart, to do it";
and it does not say "in your deeds"
as it says "in your mouth and in your heart,"
for the completion of the deed
does not depend on the person,
רַק בָּא עַל יְדֵי הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
And from the side of the person, the main thing is "in your mouth,"
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א רב, א)
as written in the holy Zohar (I 202a):
that breaks the yetzer hara except Torah."
the place of new insights in halachah
And "in your heart" is yiras Shamayim,
עַל מִי שֶׁאֵין בּוֹ יִרְאַת שָׁמַיִם
about one who has no yiras Shamayim."
And through yirah he is a mighty man
and might is chiefly in the heart,
"whose heart is like the heart of a lion."
And this is what it says, "the king is not":
that is, the Sages, who are called kings,
that is, many words of Torah,
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (בְּרָכוֹת סד, א)
along the lines of what they said (Berachos 64a):
יֵלְכוּ מֵחַיִל אֶל חָיִל (תְּהִלִּים פד, ח)
and Rashi explained: from yeshivah to yeshivah
and from beis midrash to beis midrash;
"a mighty man" is one who conquers his inclination
he is not rescued by the great strength of his might.
Nevertheless, Torah and yirah do help,
"The horse is a falsehood for salvation":
this corresponds to the man of deeds,
for a horse is a metaphor
for a person's activity and alacrity
who ran before Me like horses";
that through deeds he will be saved
and rescued from the yetzer hara,
for the completion of the deed
is from Hashem Yisbarach, as was said.
And so for all three activities,
the main salvation is from Hashem Yisbarach,
ה׳ לֹא יַעַזְבֶנּוּ בְיָדוֹ (תְּהִלִּים לז, לג)
"Hashem will not leave him in his hand" (Tehillim 37:33).
"Behold, the eye of Hashem is upon those who fear Him,
upon those who hope for His kindness":
for Hashem Yisbarach saves them in His kindness.
And this is what he said: "'A woman of valor':
we call it Torah she'b'al peh.
"Who is the mistress of many legions":
that is, words of Torah, new insights in halachah,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (הַקְדָּמָה, חֵלֶק א ה, ב)
as written in the holy Zohar (Introduction, I 5b);
וְזֶה נֶגֶד גִּבּוֹר הַכּוֹבֵשׁ אֶת יִצְרוֹ
and this corresponds to the mighty man who conquers his inclination.
And the Name Ado-nai denotes yirah,
also alludes to the performance of the mitzvah,
as written in the holy Zohar
(חֵלֶק ג קכג, רֵישׁ ע״ב, בְּרַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא)
(III, beginning of 123b, in the Ra'aya Mehemna):
which are son and daughter," etc.
And this too is what is meant
by the reading of other editions:
and all of them are called children
of the Holy One, blessed be He, and of Knesses Yisrael."
yirah, and the performance of the mitzvah,
all of which are the secret of Knesses Yisrael,
And Shabbos is the "woman of valor"
דְּאִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א מז, ב)
as it says in the holy Zohar (I 47b):
we call it Torah she'b'al peh.
And so on Shabbos the mouth was created in the soul,
that is, that it should be
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זוֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רא, ב)
And so on Shabbos all of Yisrael are called
which is equal to all the mitzvos,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּמִּדְרָשׁ (שְׁמוֹת רַבָּה כה, יב)
as written in the Midrash (Shemos Rabbah 25:12)
for it crowns and becomes a crown
for the Holy One, blessed be He;
that Hashem Yisbarach glories in Yisrael,
and this is the tefillin of the Master of the world,
and this crown is called Tiferes,
which is the tefillin of the Master of the world;
and this is "and it is all one."
"'A woman of valor, who can find?':
this is Knesses Yisrael, as we said";
'which will find you at the end of days.'"
That is, "who" is the attribute of Binah,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זוֹהַר חֵלֶק ב קטו, ב)
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קפט, ב)
as written in the holy Zohar (II 189b):
who is the end of days."
That is, the days of Creation
Now the three holinesses of Shabbos
are called in the holy Zohar
the Shabbos of the day, the Shabbos of the night";
that is, the attribute of night and the attribute of day,
the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah,
And the upper Shabbos, which is Binah,
in the Tikkunim Acharonim (end of Tikkun 5):
this is as it is written,
Now from the holy Zohar above it is clear
so how does it say in the Tikkunim
אַךְ בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג ד, א)
who never part from one another";
and so "who," which alludes to Binah,
And the union of Chochmah and Binah
and Daas is the inner dimension
and whoever merits the upper Shabbos
הוּא זוֹכֶה לִקְדוּשַּׁת כָּל הַג׳ רִאשׁוֹנוֹת
merits the holiness of all three upper ones,
And this is what is written in the Ra'aya Mehemna
from the side of three upper levels:
and she is the fourth, the 'bas,' to them."
That is, when one merits the upper Shabbos;
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זוֹהַר חֵלֶק א רז, א)

"and all these things will find you
alludes to the days of Mashiach.
is a semblance of the World to Come,
"one sixtieth of the World to Come"
are even more a semblance of the World to Come,
only about the days of Mashiach."
And in the prophecies it says explicitly,
"And it shall be on that day,"
that is, in the World to Come,
when the attribute of "Hu" will be revealed;
the Hidden One who is called "Hu"
(as written in the Idra, Ha'azinu, III 290a).
But in the days of Mashiach
there will also be a revelation
which is the World to Come.
which is called the upper Mother,
nevertheless the days of Mashiach too
And this is what it says (Devarim 4:29),
Hashem your God, and you will find":
that is, in the days of Mashiach,
who comes when attention is diverted,
like a find, as was said.
and all these things find you
that is, in the days of Mashiach,
which are also called "the end of days";
"and you will return up to Hashem your God,"
that it reaches up to the Throne of Glory,
that is, up to the World to Come,
upon which the Ancient of Days sits.
And on Shabbos every one of Yisrael
merits the attribute of Knesses Yisrael,
"in your mouth and in your heart, to do it,"
and to be found with her always";
that is, that they merit the upper Shabbos

and who will stand in His holy place?'"
to ascend the mountain of Hashem,

paragraphs.text: Source of the quoted words: Chullin 135b — “מזוזה אף על גב דכתיב (דברים ו, ט) ביתך דידך אין שותפות לא כתב רחמנא (דברים יא, כא) למען ירבו ימיכם וימי בניכם ואלא ביתך למאי אתא לכדרבה דאמר רבה” — “Likewise, with regard to a mezuza, Rabbi Ilai concedes that the house of two partners is obligated, even though it is written: “And you shall write them upon the doorposts of your house [beitekha]” (Deuteronomy 6:9), with a singular pronoun, …”
